## Governance Rules

- Use source files as the authority and archived docs as historical context only.
- Preserve tenant isolation across `site_id`, `[store]`, `[subdomain]`, RLS policies, and worker ownership checks.
- Do not add new behavior without updating relevant local AGENTS.md and regenerating the master intelligence document.
- Keep secrets out of documentation. Reference env variable names only.
- Subdomain resolution and storefront rendering must remain tenant-scoped.
- ISR/cache invalidation must include the tenant identifier.
- Preview/mock routes must not leak into production commerce logic.
